title: Goal-only evolution run and durable stage receipts

review_format_normalization.description: Server-owned lossless projection of a unique complete archived reviewer JSON object. Original verdicts are unchanged; field_paths identify full strings represented by digest-bound pointers. Source offset/end bound the exact JSON within the preserved original response.

evidence_status.const: source_access_only; no correctness or value verdict

requested_budget.description: Optional cumulative limits; omitted, null or 0 dimensions are unlimited. Positive integers impose limits.

max_attempts.description: Inclusive execution attempts; omitted, null or 0 is unlimited, 1 disables automatic repair.

require_command_execution.description: Current executor must retain correlated successful run_command output before review.

require_requirement_originals.description: Frozen requirement-original gate: every passing requirement needs complete delivered original references.

original_sources.description: Exact current executor originals or v3 originals with successful, scoped frozen-program history delivery; native acceptance checks owned identity and complete reviewer input delivery.

consumer_assessment.description: Advisory only, never part of the verdict: is the deliverable/interface meaningful to its consumer (model or human)? Persistent 'no' clusters signal a rubric that measures the wrong thing.

source_seq.description: Presented owner update that motivated this assignment; required for assign.
Presented owner update that motivated this assignment; required for assign.

command_execution_observed.description: Server-derived current task command observation at immutable terminal capture; not experiment correctness.

historical_source_coverage.description: Successful reviewer provider-input receipts for owned historical originals; v1/v2 remain direct-parent scoped, v3 admits frozen program history. Distinct from current submission coverage.

require_requirement_originals.description: Frozen requirement-original gate: every passing requirement needs complete delivered original references.

terminal_checkpoint.description: Server-owned terminal metadata committed atomically in the owned task result after all immutable source parts are acknowledged. Parts alone authorize no progression.

stage_dispatch.description: Server-owned CAS fence between binding and submission. Bound resident carriers resume in their recorded process. One cold restoration per frozen stage requires exact prepared input, proven process death and an unchanged administrator-interrupted birth. Admitted never authorizes replay.

hypothesis_assessment.description: Independent reviewer judgments tied to the exact frozen hypothesis. Separate evidence axes; technical success never establishes demand or net value. Does not replace acceptance or grant learning rights.

delivery.description: Explicit final reply. Only as the sole tool call of the final executor round after verification; requests frozen artifacts plus normal terminal delivery, never acceptance.

fingerprint_path.description: Read-only streaming SHA-256 of a stable project file; no contents retained or execution proof.

fingerprint_scope_field.description: Compare raw-file SHA-256 with this field in the current run frozen measurement_scope; caller cannot substitute an expected digest. Does not prove execution or input use.

artifact_declare_request.description: Capture one path or up to16 unique paths, optionally with an authored delivery. Alternatively select delivery_source only to deliver the exact already sealed UTF-8 body via the live terminal port. Batch captures are independent, not atomic.

artifact_declare_batch_result.description: Independent per-file declaration acknowledgements only; complete means every requested snapshot was sealed, not cross-file consistency, semantic correctness or review acceptance.

review_reserve.description: Optional amounts withheld from every executing attempt for independent review within the original cumulative budget. Zero/omitted means no reserve. Positive amounts require a strictly larger finite corresponding budget; estimates and provider overrun may still prevent review.

artifact_delivery_intent.description: Owner/run/task/project inherited from the manifest. Text delivery stores bounded authored content; source delivery stores only an immutable UTF-8 generation reference, its body remains in sealed parts. Neither intent authorizes cold completion or replay.

artifact_delivery_source.description: Exact already sealed UTF-8 generation owned by this executor, not a live file or an inferred claim.

evidence_audit.description: Unresolved material acceptance objections from independent review. Contradictions refuse pass, unsupported evidence remains unknown; an empty complete audit is a model judgment, not scientific proof.

stage_task_config.description: Immutable pre-hook task settings. Submission may only tighten limits; explicit owner model changes create a linked successor.

scientific_protocol.description: Precommitted reported-observation consistency policy; canonical Research protocol, never inferred from terminal output. Implies current command evidence.

capture_policy_version.description: Current captured-output completeness policy. Optional in legacy archives; absence cannot establish current-policy validity.

scientific_audit.description: Server recomputation over retained correlated command observations, not authenticity, full attempt completeness, formal significance or goal completion.

scientific_required_outcome.description: Optional frozen numeric acceptance target. A review cannot override a valid measurement that misses this outcome.

execution_checkpoint.description: Observed consumption lower bound from a running task checkpoint; no terminal outcome, completeness or replay authority.

phase.description: Progress order within one round; settlement advances the round. Terminal delivery cannot return to execution.

working_checkpoint.description: Replaceable model working context; phase and binding are observations, never autonomous replay authority.

working_checkpoint_part.description: Legacy unversioned sha256 binds the full body; v2 sha256 binds decoded frame bytes. The header always binds the complete body.

model_attempts.description: Optional for older contexts; new producers retain every unfinished lease in account ordinal order. Absence means details were not recorded.

continuity_effects.description: Observed unfinished work; absent account, empty commands or ready phase grant no executor replay authority.

prepared_input_manifest.description: Immutable multipart post-hook input; published only after all frames are acknowledged. The existing prepared_input_ref binds the complete canonical body digest.

continuity_model_attempt.description: Unfinished account-local model admission, observed under the account lock. Reserved tokens are authorization holds, not measured consumption or a provider usage upper bound.

model_attempt_event.description: Immutable send intent or terminal observation for one account-local provider attempt. Intent acknowledgement precedes dispatch; intent alone does not establish provider acceptance.

account_observed_tokens.description: Observed shared-account token consumption under its lock; excludes reservation holds and never asserts completeness. Optional in earlier witnesses.

child_lifecycle_event.description: Shared-account attachment intent, voided attachment or detachment. Detachment is not task/effect quiescence.

pending_tool_attempts.description: Executor observations still pending for this original control identity, including detached carrier aliases. Absence in old records means unrecorded, not zero.

scope.description: Optional in legacy executor-only observations; hook batches do not charge a tool slot.

tool_attempt_event.description: Executor intent and return/exception observation. A returned background handle is not completed external work. No handler success or replay authority.

account_tool_calls.description: Observed charged shared-account tool slots, not completed effects; optional in earlier witnesses.

scope.description: Optional in legacy executor-only observations; hook batches do not charge a tool slot.

hook_errors.description: Caught callback exceptions in a hook batch; absent legacy values are unknown, and batch return does not imply callback success.

encoding.description: Optional bounded lossless UTF-8 compression; absent means original text.

submission_voided.description: Run CAS proves no task-engine submission; zero tokens/tools and observed pre-submission wall time, no outcome or verdict.

model_attempt_tokens.description: Sum of distinct acknowledged terminal model observations; combined with checkpoints by maximum, never duplicate addition.

evidence_status.const: Observed file bytes at read time; no content snapshot, execution or reproduction proof.

matches_precommit.description: Observed raw-file SHA-256 equals the selected frozen scope digest; no execution or scientific approval.

review_next_action.description: Advisory next step from combined current/direct-parent delivery state; never scientific validity or acceptance authority.

actuals_complete.description: False means observed counters are a lower bound; consumption was lost with a worker.

absolute_deadline_at.description: Internal launch-stamped absolute program deadline; waiting or pause never extends it.

max_attempts.description: Inclusive execution attempt limit; 0 is unlimited. Legacy records without this field retain their two-attempt policy.

snapshot_pending_reconciliation.description: Read-only terminal task overlay: status/actuals reflect observed task truth, while durable receipt settlement awaits callback or reconciliation. Reading never launches work.

budget_source.description: Provenance of the new-run budget. Missing provenance is legacy and must not silently authorize more spending.

budget.description: Cumulative goal limits; 0 is unlimited per dimension. Legacy records retain stored limits.

receipts.description: Observed per-stage usage receipts. Durable headers keep a recent suffix plus receipt_archive; public projections reconstruct complete repair history.

evidence_review_version.description: Server-frozen evidence policy: v1 objection audit; v2 requires direct-parent delivery for validation successors; v3 also records owner-scoped frozen program history delivery separately. Saved runs retain their version.

research_review_version.description: Server-frozen acceptance policy for new research runs. Pipeline delivery leaves falsification unknown with exploratory learning rights; absent legacy runs retain their original verdict mapping.

require_command_execution.description: Current executor must retain correlated successful run_command output before review.

receipt_archive.description: Owner-bound immutable historical prefix, published only through the run CAS. Public run projections already expand this prefix into receipts.

require_requirement_originals.description: Frozen requirement-original gate: every passing requirement needs complete delivered original references.
